sentence: This project develops a model of how radio frequency signals travel in complex three-dimensional environments, using Neural Radiance Fields.
This project sets up an X-ray photoelectron spectrometer that measures the surface composition and elemental oxidation states of materials.
This project studies how the brain decides whether to combine information from the senses, and how it does so over time and approximately.
This project develops a wearable ultrasound device that continuously monitors blood flow in hospitalized patients.
This project designs peptide materials that bind and capture proteins so the proteins can be separated and purified without chromatography.
This project develops a microscopy method that shows how electrons and holes move in semiconductor materials under applied electrical bias.
This project tests how drought changes the active microbes and microbial gene expression in soil that affect plant growth.
This project creates an online cybersecurity program with courses and learning modules that lead to industry certifications.
This project studies how humans and maize shaped each other's history in the Americas, using genetic and archaeological data.
This project studies how the mechanical properties of a tissue affect how neutrophils, a kind of innate immune cell, work during inflammation.
This project develops methods to make transgenic lines of the hummingbird bobtail squid so it can serve as a model species.
This project designs a fault-tolerant quantum computer based on trapped-ion qubits, with error correcting codes matched to the hardware.
This project builds computer systems that find events and how they relate to each other in text written in many languages.
This project builds neural network methods that learn from single cell data and predict how biological systems change over time.
This project develops a computer method using machine learning to simulate quantum effects and the behavior of electrons in large-scale systems.
This project studies how energy use relates to differences in signaling behavior among treefrogs, including at different temperatures.
This project builds a scientific quantum computer that uses trapped ion qubits, which are single atoms handled with lasers.
This project develops pediatric prosthetics that use smart sensors and customized software.
